boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Stevens Institute of Technology
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe Hoboken food stops with current, source-backed late closing times.

cards.title: Bagels on the Hudson
cards.subtitle: 802 Washington St, Hoboken
cards.notes: Use the 24-hour pickup window for a food stop at any hour, then confirm availability directly before heading out.
cards.short_summary: A Washington Street bagel and sandwich shop listing 24-hour pickup and delivery.
cards.evidence_claim: The official site lists Bagels on the Hudson at 802 Washington St and says pickup and delivery are available 24 hours, Monday through Sunday.
cards.source_title: Bagels on the Hudson — Official Website
cards.access_notes: Official site lists pickup 24 hours daily and delivery timing of 24 hours.

cards.title: Grubbs Takeaway
cards.subtitle: 418 Washington St, Hoboken
cards.notes: Plan a pickup or delivery meal here when you need a late option; check the day-specific closing time before ordering.
cards.short_summary: A diner-style Hoboken restaurant with late closing times throughout the week.
cards.evidence_claim: Grubbs Takeaway’s official site lists 418 Washington St and closing times of 1–3 a.m., depending on the day.
cards.access_notes: Official hours: Sun until 1 a.m.; Mon–Thu until 2 a.m.; Fri–Sat until 3 a.m.

cards.title: Insomnia Cookies
cards.subtitle: 56 Newark St, Hoboken
cards.notes: Use the store page to check the current cookie-delivery window, especially if you are ordering close to the listed cutoff.
cards.short_summary: A Newark Street cookie shop whose official page advertises delivery until 3 a.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Insomnia Cookies’ official Hoboken store page states that warm cookies are delivered until 3 a.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: Official store page states: warm cookies delivered until 3 a.m. daily.

cards.title: Artichoke Basille's Pizza
cards.subtitle: 96 Hudson St, Hoboken
cards.notes: Choose a pickup or order window that fits the listed closing time; weekend hours extend later than the weekday schedule.
cards.short_summary: A Hudson Street pizza shop with late-night hours every day.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Hoboken location page lists hours of 11 a.m.–2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 11 a.m.–3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official location page: Sun–Thu 11 a.m.–2 a.m.; Fri–Sat 11 a.m.–3 a.m.

cards.title: Pizza Republic
cards.subtitle: 406 Washington St, Hoboken
cards.notes: Save this for a Friday or Saturday food run, and place pickup or delivery orders before the late closing time.
cards.short_summary: A Washington Street pizza restaurant with 2 a.m. weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Republic’s official site lists 406 Washington St and Friday and Saturday hours ending at 2 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official hours: Friday and Saturday, 10:30 a.m.–2 a.m.; takeout and delivery are offered.

cards.title: Tony Boloney's
cards.subtitle: 263 First St, Hoboken
cards.notes: Use the direct ordering page for a Friday or Saturday pickup or delivery plan, and verify the current service status first.
cards.short_summary: A First Street pizza restaurant with 2 a.m. Friday and Saturday ordering hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Tony Boloney’s official ordering page lists its Hoboken address and Friday–Saturday hours of 10 a.m.–2 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official ordering page lists Friday and Saturday hours until 2 a.m.

cards.title: Basile's Pizza
cards.subtitle: 89 Washington St, Hoboken
cards.notes: Order pickup or delivery through the shop’s direct page when the 2 a.m. closing time suits your evening schedule.
cards.short_summary: A Washington Street pizza shop listing service until 2 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Basile’s official website lists its Hoboken address at 89 Washington St and hours of 11 a.m.–2 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official website lists 11 a.m.–2 a.m. and provides ordering options.

cards.title: 7th Street Burger
cards.subtitle: 410 Washington St, Hoboken
cards.notes: Check the ordering page before leaving, then use the later Thursday through Saturday closing times for a late meal plan.
cards.short_summary: A Washington Street burger restaurant with late service on select nights.
cards.evidence_claim: The restaurant’s direct ordering page lists 410 Washington St and hours until 1 a.m. Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official ordering page: Thursday until 1 a.m.; Friday and Saturday until 3 a.m.

cards.title: The Brick
cards.subtitle: 1122 Washington St, Hoboken
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s ordering page to confirm the active pickup hours before going, particularly around the overnight weekend listing.
cards.short_summary: A Washington Street pizza restaurant with late Friday and Saturday pickup availability.
cards.evidence_claim: The Brick’s official ordering page lists 1122 Washington St and Friday and Saturday takeout hours extending into the early morning.
cards.access_notes: Official ordering page lists Friday takeout through 4 a.m. and Saturday through 4 a.m., with separate evening service.

cards.title: Mamoun's Falafel
cards.subtitle: 300 Washington St, Hoboken
cards.notes: Plan this for a Friday or Saturday food stop and check the official location page before placing a takeout or delivery order.
cards.short_summary: A Washington Street Middle Eastern restaurant open until midnight on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Mamoun’s official Hoboken page lists 300 Washington St and Friday–Saturday hours of 11 a.m.–midnight.
cards.access_notes: Official location page: Sunday–Thursday until 11 p.m.; Friday–Saturday until midnight; takeout runs open to close.
